apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). About $0.001 for a default 256 MB run.

product-card.eventDescription: Charged once per SUCCESSFUL product card returned from any source (upcitemdb, barcodelookup, or openfoodfacts) and saved to the dataset. Not charged: not found, missing key when OFF also misses / OFF disabled, 4xx after retries, unauthorized, rate limited, invalid input, timeouts.
